replies.author: OldManTigerMask
replies.body:
Ah, well I'm working on it here: https://github.com/OldManTigerMask/Map-XML-Service/blob/master/XMLDoneitI.XML you can contribute to it so I don't have to ask you for coordinates etc. . I've explained things inside the comment section.
----
Also how to find the location of the monument, here's how:
Put a block directly below the monument
Destroy the monument (litterally)
Stand on the newly placed block below the monument
Press F3
Then record the coordinates (or write it down)
place the obsidian monument back
Then remove the block below

Since you recorded the coordinates you can just replace them inside the GITHUB I've set up.
Also if any map experts could help with this that'd be great
